test_title: PYST 54: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A structure in the garden where climbing plants can grow and people can walk under
solution:
The correct answer is Option (3) i.e. **'Pergola'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A structure in the garden where climbing plants can grow and people can walk under:** (एक संरचना जो बगीचे में होती है जहां चढ़ाई वाले पौधे उग सकते हैं और लोग इसके नीचे चल सकते हैं)
 
• **Pergola: **(पर्गोला) - (An outdoor garden feature forming a shaded walkway, passageway, or sitting area of vertical posts or pillars.
 
 
• **Example**: They had dinner under the pergola covered in flowering vines.
 
 
 
• **Pergola **correctly describes a structure designed for supporting climbing plants and providing a shaded area underneath for people to walk through or sit under.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Pergola'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tomb**: (समाधि) - (A large vault, typically an underground one, for burying the dead)

 
 
• **Example**: The ancient tomb was discovered during an archaeological excavation.
 
 
 
• **Outhouse**: (बाहरी शौचालय) - (An outbuilding serving as a toilet, typically with no plumbing)
 
 
• **Example**: The old farmhouse still had an outhouse in the backyard.
 
 
 
• **Treehouse**: (पेड़ का घर) - (A small house or structure built in the branches of a tree for children to play in)
 
 
• **Example**: The kids spent the summer building a treehouse in the old oak tree.
